purpose: Review priority for tools/drum-reviewer: bars where mix-level ADTOF labels are most likely wrong, so humans fix the bad sections first. Not ground truth; the scorer never reads it.

inputs: edm/drums_adtof_stem (ADTOF on the HT-Demucs drum stem)
per-track features from the Spark gpu_task below

features.drum_stems: the htdemucs separate jobs listed in edm/drums_adtof_stem/PROVENANCE.json
features.note: band envelopes have a 44-sample hop (0.9977 ms at 44.1 kHz), recorded as os_hop_s

evaluation_2026-11-26.ground_truth: dnb-energetic-breakbeat owner draft: 0 s of reviewed ranges, so only the 32 hits the owner added (5 kicks, 27 snares) are known corrections; scripts/drum_suspect_eval.py

tiers.high: 17/32 corrections in 21% of the track (2.5x random)

evaluation_2026-11-26.weights: disagreement and pattern-missing weighted equally (independent evidence; disagreement is partly circular here because ADTOF on the stem found 22 of the 27 snares); unexpected and filter only break ties
evaluation_2026-11-26.caveat: One track, 32 hits, no reviewed negatives. Re-check once reviewed ranges exist.
evaluation_2026-11-26.expected_hits: 24/32 of the owner's added hits (5 kicks, 27 snares) are within +-30 ms of a same-class expected-hit marker (22 within +-10 ms); the track has 57 markers, 48 at a measured attack. The other 8 had P<0.5 or too weak an attack.

schema_history.1: per-bar evidence counts, score, rank, tier, ranges (2026-11-26, #15)
schema_history.2: adds per-bar `expected`: each expected-but-missing hit (P>=0.5, no mix label, attack present) as {time, type, p, attack, at}; `at` is "attack" when the time is the strongest 150 Hz-5 kHz onset-strength peak of the mix or drum stem within +-min(20 ms, 0.4 slot) of the slot (a local maximum at least the attack threshold), else "grid" (the slot's grid time). Every other field is unchanged.

regenerated_2026-11-26.how: scripts/drum_suspect.py on the build host, from the same Spark feature files (fetched from the object store with blinky-server's Spark client); one-shot CPU run
regenerated_2026-11-26.check: every map is identical to schema 1 apart from `schema` and the added `expected` lists (scores, ranks, tiers and ranges unchanged); 1004 expected hits over the 18 tracks, one per missing_kick/missing_snare count, 942 placed at a measured attack
regenerated_2026-11-26.placement_choice: the 150 Hz-5 kHz band of mix and stem (max) with the attack threshold; on dnb-energetic-breakbeat the grid time alone puts 23/32 added hits within 30 ms (20 within 10 ms), the attack peak 24/32 (22 within 10 ms, median error 0.2 ms); the mix's band alone 23/32
